sections.title: Lord of the Flies — Chapter 12 (summary, 3)

paras.text: The officer is shocked that two were killed and offers to take them off the island. Asked who is boss, Ralph says he is; he does not know how many boys there are. The officer remarks that British boys should have “put up a better show”; Ralph says it was like that at first, when they were together.
